targets.review_note: The weighted sequence generating function is (1-x)^2(1-y)^2/(1-2x-2y+2xy)^2. Expanding around (1-2x)(1-2y) gives a finite j sum with coefficient (j+1)2^(n+m-j)[C(n,j)+C(n-1,j+1)/4] times the analogous m factor. Factorial arrays support all queries in linear total smaller dimension, with exact modular inverses.

targets.review_note: In lexical trie DFS, completion rank from an ancestor equals current global selected rank plus1 minus the ancestor subtree start rank. Maintain the minimum ancestor typing-cost minus start-rank along each path. Ordinary character edges cost1; selected nodes can also autocomplete. Capture start rank before counting a selected prefix itself, which remains in descendant completion menus. No recursion on million-node tries.

targets.review_note: Top view fixes each occupied cell at at least1. Row/column view obligations cost height-1 above that baseline. Sharing an obligation is possible only at occupied intersections of equal row and column maxima. Bipartite matching maximizes such savings independently within each height component; rearrangement need not preserve original individual heights.

targets.review_note: A single replacement shifts every later shot by a constant in[-2,2]. Maintain five suffix hit multiplicity maps and their counts not already in the unchanged prefix. Remove the current original shot before evaluating replacements, add a possible replacement shot without double-counting, then advance the original prefix. Counts represent distinct destroyed targets, not shot counts.

targets.review_note: The y-coordinate cancels when comparing distances to bowls on y=0; ties go to the left bowl. Prefix cat counts at adjacent chosen-bowl midpoints determine each load. For a selected final bowl, the largest feasible incoming prefix count dominates all smaller ones for extensions. Binary-search the maximum load with an O(M^2) feasibility DP; any bowl can be first and the final suffix is explicitly checked.

targets.review_note: Each starting chip uniquely determines one move. Maintain linked nearest neighbors in both row and column directions, saving the next directed chip before unlinking the current chip in all four directions. Independent copies per start preserve the original board; total simulation is quadratic in at most5000 chips, with constant-time deletion and no repeated ray scans.
